Behind the name

Fourteen years of Washington asphalt

A licensed Bonney Lake paving contractor that still runs its own trucks, its own paver and its own crews.

Everything on a job belongs to the same outfit — the dump trucks that bring the mat, the paver that lays it, the rollers behind it and the walk-behind striper that puts the lines in at the end. Nothing gets handed to a sub halfway through, which is why the schedule tends to hold and why a driveway, a tie-in and the neighbors' two drives can all land on one day.

Registration ROADSPW883M6 is active with Washington L&I and the company is a BBB accredited business. Estimates are free and the truck comes to you — reviewers regularly mention getting a quote the same day they called, and getting a crew back out when something needed putting right.
